content:
When writing

def Foo := Bar
deriving Add

We would like the instance to be called Foo.instAdd. However, the instance instead gets called instAddFoo. This had been discussed before (though I think only on GitHub).

To do this change, I think initially, the deriving handler should create a deprecated version of the instance, with the old name.

Should I make a Lean issue for this?
Do we really need a deprecated version? At least in mathlib, the policy is to skip deprecations when renaming instances
(IIRC, there was no deprecation when the auto-naming algorithm was changed)
